Flag Atlas / Technical / other / disable_load_v2_klp
Gboard developer flag · Technical / other

Disable V2 KLP Loading

Disables an internal V2 KLP-loading configuration in Gboard’s Latin typing engine. KLP resources include versioned language and prediction-model assets. The precise fallback behavior is not verified.

disable_load_v2_klp
Find in full AtlasSuggest correction ↗

Interpretation and limitations

This flag is classified under Technical / other with Optional priority and an estimated impact of Usually low.

Evidence level: Interpreted. This interpretation is based on the identifier and surrounding context; exact effects are not independently confirmed.

Research note: Direct read-only APK disassembly, GboardWu 18.5.4.993608717: classes.dex Lifb.<clinit> registers disable_load_v2_klp as a boolean with declared default false. classes5.dex com.google.android.apps.inputmethod.libs.latin5.LatinIme.O() reads the flag and, when true, sets option bit 0x8 and Lyqx.c=true; it also consumes lazy_load_klp_sections (default entries include spatial_model_features and monolingual_pk_trigger_model). DelightKlpDownloader, versioned klp_locales/klp_versions and key-correction model references show KLP includes language/model resources. KLP expansion, V1 fallback, actual remotely overridden value and performance impact remain unverified.
